subject: RE: MAP — Integration milestones & action runway
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Priya Kapoor <priya.k@stellar-retail.com>, James O'Neill <james.oneill@edgecommerce.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: integration milestones + weekly sync

Hi Priya, James —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, I set up a short weekly checkpoint to track the mutual action plan (MAP) items around SDK/API integration, auth, streaming, and the evaluation plan. Goal is to keep the runbook tight so your engineering team can validate the POC and procurement can land on timelines.

Proposed agenda for first sync (30 mins):
- Quick status: SDK integration (init + streaming) — Camila
- Auth & keys: SSO/KMS questions — Monica
- Eval plan: prompt set, metrics, pass/fail criteria — Aditya
- Close runway: procurement steps & target sign date — Alex

Can you confirm availability for a recurring Tue 11:00 AM PDT slot starting next week? If that doesn't work, share two alternative windows. Also including a lightweight MAP workbook (attached) — please add any missing owners.

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Kapoor <priya.k@stellar-retail.com>

Cc: James O'Neill <james.oneill@edgecommerce.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: integration milestones + weekly sync

Thanks, Aditya — this looks good. Tue 11:00 AM PDT works for our engineers (Priya and James will join the first two sessions). A couple of notes before we sync:

- Procurement is working towards a 9/10 target sign date; we have a commercial review next Friday that could shift it +/- 1 week.
- On auth: we need to confirm whether Redwood can support our SSO + customer-managed KMS for embeddings and logs. Is there a short doc you can share on the supported KMS flows?
- For the eval plan, can you include an initial latency SLA for streaming (p95 target) so we can set expectations with the infra team?

Also, we may upload a short sample dataset for the eval during the call. Please confirm the preferred format.

— Priya
Head of ML Engineering
Stellar Retail

Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff: integration milestones + weekly sync — SDK & streaming update

Hi all — quick technical update ahead of the first checkpoint:

1) SDK integration (initial):
- Status: Basic SDK auth + generate call completed against Redwood sandbox. Sample app (node) completed by our SE team.
- Blocker: We still need an API key rotation policy from Stellar (format: header vs token exchange). Priya, can you share how your current internal key rotation is done?

2) Streaming & tool calling:
- Status: Streaming prototype returns partial tokens at ~80ms per chunk in our sandbox for 512-token seq. We saw an edge-case when client interrupts and resumes; Code path for graceful resume needs a small change (we've outlined in the attached auth_flow_diagram.png).
- Action: We'll push a small helper to the SDK repo to handle resumed streams (ETA 48h after auth flow is resolved).

3) Auth / KMS:
- Monica and I validated that Redwood supports customer-managed KMS via our KMS bridge, but the handshake requires a service principal with limited privileges (details in attachment). We'll need an onboarding ticket for your security team.

Action items (internal owners shown):
- Camila: finalize streaming resume helper and PR to SDK repo — due 2026-08-07
- Monica: prepare KMS onboarding doc + sample IAM role — due 2026-08-06 (attachment: auth_flow_diagram.png)
- Aditya: add latency SLA targets and evaluation criteria to MAP workbook — due 2026-08-07

Attachments: auth_flow_diagram.png

Priya / James —

Quick commercial note: the 9/10 sign date lines up with a Q3 commit window on our side. If procurement needs a two-week accelerated review, we can provide an interim sandbox SLA and temporary credits to keep the POC scope intact while legal finalizes terms. Happy to coordinate with your procurement lead — can you share a contact?

Also, if Stellar's security team needs to run the KMS onboarding in parallel with the PO, we can accept a conditioned committal so infra work isn't blocked.

Short ask to internal team: prioritize the KMS onboarding doc so we can hand to Stellar's security this week.

— Alex Martinez
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Subject: MAP sync notes (2026-08-10) — decisions, owners, next steps

Folks — thanks for today's call. Below is the consolidated set of notes and the 'single source' action list. Please reply with any corrections by EOD Wed (2026-08-12). Next sync: Tue 2026-08-17 11:00 AM PDT (invite sent).

Decisions from today's checkpoint:
- KMS onboarding will proceed in parallel with procurement; Stellar will provide an IAM role example and Redwood will validate permissions during onboarding.
- Streaming resume helper will be merged into SDK; client will test resume flows during POC.
- Eval plan will use the sample dataset (CSV, newline-delimited JSON lines accepted). Passing criteria: relevance F1 >= 0.78 and streaming p95 latency <= 180ms on the sample workload.

Consolidated action items (owner — due date — status):
- Monica Patel — prepare KMS onboarding packet + IAM sample (auth_flow_diagram.png attached) — due 2026-08-12 — IN PROGRESS
- Camila Reyes — submit PR for streaming resume helper to SDK repo — due 2026-08-12 — IN PROGRESS
- Aditya Rao — update MAP_v3.xlsx with eval SLA and test checklist; upload eval_prompt_set_v2.jsonl to shared drive — due 2026-08-12 — TODO
- Priya Kapoor (Stellar) — provide key rotation policy example + access to small sample dataset — due 2026-08-12 — TODO
- Alex Martinez — coordinate procurement touchpoint and share procurement lead contact — due 2026-08-13 — TODO

Attachments included in thread: MAP_v3.xlsx, auth_flow_diagram.png, eval_prompt_set_v2.jsonl
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/78941, https://drive.google.com/open?id=map_v3

If there are no objections, I'll mark the KMS onboarding ticket in our tracker and share the onboarding checklist by EOD Thursday.
